QuestInfo.name: [Detective Rave's Case Notes] Dealer of Arms
QuestInfo.0: Talk to Rave again in #bSeedy Scrapyard 3#k.
QuestInfo.1: It seems that the Scrappy Hooligans sold the cargo to a merchant in the Black Market. You should meet #bCorbo#k at the #bMountain of Trash#k, then proceed to the #bBlack Market#k and talk to the merchant there.
QuestInfo.2: You met the arms dealer Plunk at the #bBlack Market#k. Would he still have the cargo?
